reviews.comment: Kibriya is a great professor, will work with you if you need any help, and offers a ton of extra credit. 2 tests that weigh 30% each that are tough and 3 write-ups worth 10% each. It's not hard, tests are challenging but he curves them. Super understanding and will work with you, class isn't an easy A but its easy to pass

Dr. Shahriar Kibriya is a great professor. He has 2 test (midterm/final) that are weighted very heavy. Other than that there's only three other assignments that aren't hard. I made below a 60 on each test and still came out with a B. He will give you a curve at the very end of the semester to boost your grade quite a bit, so don't worry!

You can learn a lot about the way the world works if you want to. Attendance isn't mandatory, but participation is a portion of your grade. Professor Kibriya is very knowledgeable on all the topics we covered; he has been doing this for his entire career. He answers any and all questions and sometimes treats the course like a discussion.
